description: Defines an abstract class 'AudioFrameBuffer' with virtual methods for audio data properties such as bits per sample, sample rate, channels, frames, and data buffer.

classes.name: AudioFrameBuffer
classes.description: An abstract class representing a buffer of audio frames with methods to access audio properties and data.

methods.name: bits_per_sample
methods.description: Returns the number of bits per audio sample.

methods.name: sample_rate
methods.description: Returns the sample rate of the audio data.

methods.name: channels
methods.description: Returns the number of audio channels.

methods.name: frames
methods.description: Returns the number of audio frames.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the audio data buffer.
